1417-4279-4616--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1417-4279-4616--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation, Bridge from Below and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Bridge from Below ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.

2281-3899-5925.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jackdaw Savior.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

4775-6495-6553.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
4775-6495-6553.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-5256-6772.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

4591-6735-8089.description:
Activate Soul Channeling by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

2438-2738-4871-6248.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Phenomenon Investigators, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4050-4094-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4050-4094-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5086-5183-6291-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4050-5086-5183-6291-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

814-3259-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-6965.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-1734-3175.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

955-1563-3899-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3000-3899-4324-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Workshop Elders.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

992-5339.description: Because Sandwurm Convergence prevents creatures with flying from attacking you, and Moat prevents creatures without flying from attacking you, no creatures can attack you.

431-1270-4772-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-4772-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1850-5414-6850.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-5414-6850.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

1495-4772-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Doubling Season.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-4772-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

1339-2122-4565-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-4565-5231.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1806-2034-2382-5465.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

252-2334-4312-4554.manaNeeded: {4}{G}{W}{U}{U} the first turn, and {G}{U} available each extra turn
252-2334-4312-4554.notablePrerequisites: Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
252-2334-4312-4554.description:
Cast Teferi by paying {4}{W}{U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature in addition to its other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the counters on Teferi.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Teferi, causing it to enter the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature in addition to its other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

413-628-914-4153.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
Dockside Extortionist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
413-628-914-4153.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all +1/+1 counters from Dockside Extortionist onto another permanent you control.
Repeat.
If opponents control six or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

539-1636-1778-5094-5196.notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
539-1636-1778-5094-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Memnite to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If you control another nontoken creature without summoning sickness, this combo nets infinite mana creatures you control can produce.

49-1216-1799-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sengir Autocrat, adding {C}{C}.
When Sengir Autocrat leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, exiling all Serf tokens.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Sengir Autocrat into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sengir Autocrat enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating three 0/1 Serf creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the Serfs, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1984-3587-5109.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}.
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Boros Reckoner and you, with Angel's Grace causing your life total to become one instead.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to target opponent.

57-2178-4659-4891.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-2178-4659-4891.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Atsushi with haste.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Atsushi token, adding {C}{C}.
Atsushi dies, triggering itself and Feldon.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Feldon trigger, untapping it.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead exile cards using Atsushi and cast them from exile this turn.

224-433-3257.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

413-628-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing all +1/+1 counters, adding that many {C}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Workhorse.
Workhorse undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station's ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
